title: OpenShift
blurb: Red Hat's enterprise Kubernetes, in depth: architecture and Operators (OLM, CSVs, subscriptions), RHCOS & MachineConfigs, etcd health and recovery, SCCs and the arbitrary-UID contract, authentication & RBAC, S2I builds, a full networking track (pod network, CNI, OVN-Kubernetes, Routes, ingress sharding, NetworkPolicy), storage and CSI in depth, scheduling, GitOps, cluster upgrades, monitoring & alerting, logging with Loki, and backup/DR with OADP.
